Medium-wide 35mm lens at eye level, Scarlett (Image 1) strides toward the camera through a narrow downtown apartment hallway, lipstick tube open in one hand and a structured canvas tote in the other, poised to snap the tube shut while moving. The cream plaster walls, implied apartment doors, and radiator shelf remain visible behind Scarlett (Image 1), with a smartphone resting on the shelf as a clear later destination. Soft natural morning light fills the corridor evenly, with gentle warmth and restrained shadows. Modern social-first beauty campaign photography, handheld editorial energy, clean bright true-to-life color, crisp neutrals, coral accent, airy lifted shadows, composed for 16:9.
